rv.q: It might just turn out to be the year's best new play.
Kushner’s play brings space science into earthly human terms with humor, thoughtfulness and snowballing suspense.
Nevertheless, the overall narrative of the play is highly engaging – even powerful – as it follows Tito's journey to self-discovery.

cn.t: Critics largely rave about *Radio Galaxy*, praising Kushner's script for blending humor, heart, and science with mounting suspense. One outlier finds it solid but less transcendent—still recommended.
